summary: Tests your internet download speed once a night and keeps a week of results.
does: Line speed downloads a test file once a night and times it, so you can tell how fast your internet line is. It measures download speed only, not upload, and uses Cloudflare's speed test.

You choose the hour of the test, 04:00 unless you change it, and the size of the file. It does not check whether anything is downloading, so choose an hour when nothing is. A bigger file is more accurate on a fast line but uses more of any data allowance. It keeps the last 14 results and shows the newest 7. A Test now button runs one at once.
for: For people who want to know whether their internet line is delivering the speed they pay for, and to notice when it drops, without running tests by hand.
needs: Nothing else beyond Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. It needs internet access to reach Cloudflare's speed test, and each test uses the chosen test size of any data allowance.
shows: Two dashboard cards: Line speed, the newest result in Mbps with its day and time, and Line speed this week, the last 7 tests newest first. Its tab has the settings Test at and Test size, and a Test now button.
